title: The Academic Department Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Departments, programs, staff directories, and official contact pages. The Academic Department Database records academic departments with their programs, published staff directories, office locations, and official contact pages. Staff records carry public professional information only: name, title, research areas, and published contact details. The Signature side adds program-comparison sheets built from the same public records.
capabilities: Record departments with programs and office locations
Maintain staff directories from published sources only
Link to official department and contact pages
Compare programs across departments on public facts
Track department renames, mergers, and splits

title: The Academic Department Database — Connection layer: public to Signature record mapping
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. The connection layer links records across both sides.
